component.name: Lattis
component.summary: A fast, fully themable game launcher for Linux

description.p: Lattis keeps emulated games, Steam games, Proton games and native Linux games in one library, stored in a single folder you can back up.
Every color, size and radius comes from a theme you can edit, and the launcher is built to start fast and stay out of the way.

screenshot.caption: The library: games grouped by platform, and a game's page
Customize: every color is a theme setting
